column1: # taking the extra 2 MB from the ffat partition
# codebase uses (every SD.* call targets the physical removable SD card
# this internal partition - see README "SD card" section).
# Kept as a genuine OTA-shaped dual app-bank table on purpose
# code writes to app1 yet: a real OTA update flow is tracked as its own
# future feature (fetch/write/validate/rollback is a project in itself)
# collapsing to a single app partition now would mean re-migrating this table
# again later instead of just turning OTA on. See docs/ or ask before
# resizing further - this repo has a documented history of a firmware-layout
# mistake bricking a watch.
